messages:
maria: FYI apac-se1 is showing a small-pod carousel: lots of 0.5 GPU pods Pending ~15m even though some nodes report free GPUs
kevin: any recent taint/label rollouts or scheduler tuning?
maria: we pushed a label rollout 20m ago changing node.k8s.redwood/zone-weight=low -> deprecated=false via automation
maria: kubectl get pods -n infra | grep Pending | wc -l -> 48
maria: example pod:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: tiny-train-xyz
spec:
  containers:
  - name: worker
    resources:
      limits:
        nvidia.com/gpu: "0.5"
    nodeSelector:
      runtime: gpu
  affinity:
    podAntiAffinity: {}
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu.preempt"
    operator: "Exists"
```
kevin: our scheduler recently enabled aggressive full-slot packing in apac clusters; half-GPU requests can be skipped if only fragmented <0.5 freebies exist
ops-bot: eviction-controller: 9 graceful-preempt evictions in last 4m on apac-se1c
maria: kubectl describe node apac-se1c-12 shows:
Allocatable: 32 GPUs
Allocated: 26 GPUs
Free fragments: multiple slots in 0.125-0.375 range
Taints: gpu.reserve=true:NoSchedule (applied)
jess: gpu.reserve should only be on warmpool nodes. Did automation hit normal nodes?
tim: warmpool automation uses regex warmpool-.*; a suffix collision with normal node names occurred in yesterday's batch rollout
kevin: combined problem: (1) accidental reserve taint reducing eligible nodes, (2) binpack prefers full-slot packing, (3) preemption thresholds avoid evicting small pods -> 0.5 requests can't find contiguous free chunk
maria: scheduler logs: "Predicate failed: Insufficient gpu" even when aggregate free >= requested but fragmented
jess: short-term fixes?
kevin: mitigation plan: 1) rollback taint misapplied to normal nodes 2) flip binpack_mode to relaxed on apac-se1 3) allow preemption of tiny pods temporarily
ims: applying taints back to warmpools only -> kubectl taint nodes apac-se1c-{10..15} gpu.reserve=true:NoSchedule -> removed where wrong -> applied to expected warmpool nodes
scheduler-bot: scheduler config updated: binpack_mode=relaxed (actor=kevin, reason=mitigate-frag-carousel)
maria: pending count dropped 48 -> 7 in 60s, but we observed 4 latency-sensitive small pods preempted unexpectedly
kevin: rolled preemption threshold back for small pods; patch deployed
tim: long-term: add invariant check to warmpool automation regex, unit test on node name patterns, and staged rollout for taint changes
jess: propose telemetry: fragment-size histogram per-az + trigger to enable fractional-coalesce when fragmentation > 25%
maria: fractional coalescing is experimental; if enabled it packs multiple tiny fragments to satisfy a larger fractional request but could increase contention/noisy neighbor risk
kevin: cost note: relaxed binpacking will spread load and raise GPU bill by ~5-7% but reduces wait time SLO risk. Approving temporary ramp for 2h
ops-bot: INC-2026-1298 created, severity=sev3, assignees=@kevin,@maria,@tim
maria: runbook summary we executed:
- identify nodes with accidental reserve taint
- revert taint on normal nodes, ensure warmpool nodes keep taint
- set scheduler binpack_mode=relaxed for apac-se1
- revert preemption thresholds for tiny pods
- monitor pending queue and preemption churn
kevin: action items: PR to fix regex and add tests, opt-in fractional coalesce experiment, telemetry for fragment distribution, per-cluster small-pod packing policy
maria: monitoring looks stable, will keep watch for 30m :thumbsup:
